_readme: Made-up example with every key auto-apply uses. Put your real details in the APPLICANT_PROFILE GitHub secret (paste the whole thing), or in applicant_profile.json (gitignored) on your own computer. Never commit your real one: this repo is public. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_phones: US numbers, any format. The form's phone boxes start with +, so the +1 is added for you.
_address: Your CURRENT address. building = the building number only (123); street_name = the rest (Example Street).
_household: household_size = everyone who will live in the apartment, including you. annual_income = the household's GROSS (before-tax) yearly income, as a plain number.
_extra_fields: Only if the site adds a field this doesn't know: its label (part of it is enough) -> what to put in it. true/false ticks or unticks a checkbox.
